title: callista perula
intro: Callista perula, commonly known as the African calabar bean or calabar nut, is a plant native to tropical Africa. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing fever, treating malaria, and acting as a purgative to relieve constipation. The therapeutic actions of Callista perula include its ability to induce purging, which is achieved through its bioactive constituents, such as calabarine and calabarine. The bioactive constituents of the plant, including calabash crystal and calabashine, are responsible for its medicinal properties, although more research is needed to fully understand its effects.
